podcast.title: First Form of Vaporwave
podcast.body: Eccojams is identified as the earliest form of vaporwave, characterized by its use of simple, repetitive loops typically centered on lyrical fragments of songs, creating an echo and reverberation-laden collage. "El Eco Yams fue la primera forma del vaporwave. Se caracteriza por el uso de lup simples y repetitivos, generalmente centrados en fragmentos líricos de canciones, que crean un colach cargado de eco y reverberación."

srcs.episode: Vaporwave: Mucho más que un Meme

podcast.title: Inspired by Audio Manipulation Techniques
podcast.body: The genre draws inspiration from techniques like Chop 'n' Screw and Plunderphonics, involving the slowing down and fragmentation of tracks to introduce a glitch-like effect. "El Eco Yams toma inspiración de técnicas como el Chopeta N' Escriway o el Plonder Phonics, ralentizando y fragmentando las pistas para darle un toque glitch."

srcs.episode: Vaporwave: Mucho más que un Meme

podcast.title: Raw and Chaotic Precursor
podcast.body: Eccojams is considered the raw and chaotic precursor to vaporwave, having emerged directly from *Chuck Person's Eccojams Vol. 1* and further developed by artists such as MediaFired and Bodycode. "Es el precursor crudo y caótico del vaporwave, surgido a raíz del citado álbum Jack Persons Eco Yams volumen 1"
